sentences.ar: بعد كم يوم، سكروا باب المغارة بحديد.
sentences.en: A few days later, they closed the cave door with iron.

sentences.ar: توم سمع وقال: بس جو جوا!
sentences.en: Tom heard and said: but Joe is inside!
They opened the door and found him dead beside it.
They buried him at the mouth of the cave.

sentences.ar: توم وهَك رجعوا للمغارة من الفتحة التانية.
sentences.en: Tom and Huck went back to the cave by the other opening.

sentences.ar: لقوا الصندوق تحت صليب على حجر.
sentences.en: They found the box under a cross on a rock.
They brought it up and carried it, hardly believing.
The Widow Douglas took Huck in with her.

sentences.ar: لبسته تياب نظيفة وعلمته يقعد عالطاولة.
sentences.en: She dressed him in clean clothes and taught him to sit at the table.

sentences.ar: هَك تحمل ثلاث أسابيع وبعدين هرب.
sentences.en: Huck endured three weeks and then ran away.

sentences.ar: توم لقاه براميل قديمة وهو مبسوط.
sentences.en: Tom found him among old barrels, content.
He said to him: come back, and I will let you into my gang.

sentences.ar: هَك فكر شوي وقال: طيب، بجرب كمان مرة.
sentences.en: Huck thought a little and said: all right, I will try once more.
